label: Text 1
transcript: Sam wakes up at 6:30. Brushes teeth. Lets the cat out. Eats two pieces of toast and three slices of cheese, in that exact order. Walks to school in less than twelve minutes. Lina wakes up at 7:00, runs out the door at 7:25, and arrives at school out of breath but before the bell. Sam still doesn't understand how. Lina says: the bell is on my side.
